profile.name: HARSH RAJPAL

education.degree: Bachelors’ of Computer Science and Engineering, Specialization in Information Security

description: Led the automation of delivery data flow to the transportation team, enhancing operational efficiency and projected annual savings exceeding 1M USD.
Worked on a weekly update functionality that sends weekly office to all employees using Spring Boot
Worked on an invoice conversion functionality that converts external invoices to our system-supported invoice using ABAP.
Working and developing a notification service from scratch using AWS SQS, SES, SNS and SAP, effectively supporting over 100,000 delivery partners with reliable SMS and email delivery.
Learnt and applied HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React to develop multiple web pages during the internship period.

projects.name: Analysis of phone users
projects.description: Conducted an extensive data analysis on a cell phone user market’s data of 1,000,000 users available on Kaggle using MySQL.

projects.name: Resume Builder
projects.description: An application that gives 10 options to make a resume from various available formats using the information stored in MongoDB.

projects.name: Women Status in India
projects.description: Built a dashboard using Power BI and Tableau to analyze and understand the status of women in India and underlying factors like education, age, etc., by applying various data visualization methods and running SQL queries.

projects.name: Assisted Vision
projects.description: A web application designed to facilitate the learning process for physically challenged learners. It aims to provide a simple and accessible method for physically disabled students to interact with and learn by loading and storing the files in the local database.

projects.name: Traffic Police Hand Sign Detection
projects.description: An application to detect 12 hand signs shown by traffic police using machine learning algorithms built using Python and the MoveNet model.

projects.name: Library Management System
projects.description: Worked on making a library management system in an engineering college using SQL and learned new concepts by working on a live project.
